profile.headline: Assoc. Software Engineer @ Liberty Mutual | University of Florida Alumna
profile.summary: Hi, I'm Sara Smith! I'm an Associate Software Engineer at Liberty Mutual and a recent alumna of the University of Florida. I am passionate about learning, problem-solving, and educating others while finding creative solutions.

positions.title: Technology Associate
positions.description:
• Planned, built, and shipped UI modernizations from Angular to Next.js (React, TypeScript), improving performance, usability, and maintainability for key internal workflows used across the company 
• Partnered closely with product owners and engineers to shape feature scopes, evaluate tradeoffs, and ensure that shipped experiences solved real user pain points and met stakeholder needs 
• Migrated 9 CI/CD pipelines from Bamboo to GitHub Actions, automating workflows in YAML and coordinating with multiple teams to tailor pipelines, migrate artifacts, and meet a critical company-wide deadline

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Built an internal tool using Next.js (React, TypeScript) to simplify repetitive policy management tasks, eliminating manual errors in Telematics policy management workflows 
• Designed and implemented RESTful API endpoints in a Java-based service to share policy data and power frontend functionality
• Collaborated with engineers, product owners, and managers in an Agile environment to ensure seamless integration

positions.title: STEM Instructor
positions.description:
• Designed and delivered daily STEM lessons to 15-20 third-grade students, adapting communication strategies to effectively explain complex concepts to diverse learning levels
• Directed activities with the Edison Robot involving EdScratch block-based code, culminating in a final coding project presented to local government officials

projects.title: PayArray (Next.js, Python, Flask)
projects.description:
Pay away with PayArray!
• Collaborated on a web application that streamlines expense-sharing within households groups
• Illustrated wireframes to plan and visualize the structure of the app, ensuring an intuitive user experience
• Crafted dynamic drop-down components to effectively select people or transactions for payment and requests

projects.title: WingIt (JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, Flask)
projects.description:
Best Project by First Time Hackers at Winghacks!
• Developed an interview preparation web app that mimics a realistic interview environment by delivering behavioral questions verbally, allowing users to practice and record responses
• Collaborated on frontend development to create interactive interfaces featuring interview rounds and question-specific feedback with a custom mascot, Cornelius the Cat

organizations.name: Rewriting the Code
organizations.description: Rewriting the Code is a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit organization which supports and empowers college, graduate and early career women in tech, through intersectional communities, mentorship, industry experience and educational resources, to become the next generation of engineers and tech leaders.

organizations.name: UF Women in Computer Science and Engineering (ACM-W)
organizations.position: Outreach Committee Member and Mentor · Aug 2022 - Dec 2024
organizations.description: An official student ACM-W chapter that dedicates to increasing the representation of women in Computer Science.
